title: Anatomy figure
describe: Anatomical figures with named parts, drawn from real illustrations (credits in CREDITS.md): figure is skeleton, muscles (front), muscles-back, heart, brain or cell. In prompt, `highlight` tints one part ("name the highlighted bone") and the rest of the drawing goes grey. In respond, the figure is in colour and the user clicks a part; `target` is the right one (score 1, else 0) and is shown on reveal. Parts — skeleton: skull, mandible, clavicle, scapula, sternum, ribs, spine, humerus, radius, ulna, hand, pelvis, femur, patella, tibia, fibula, foot; muscles: sternocleidomastoid, trapezius, deltoid, pectoralis, biceps, brachioradialis, forearm, abdominis, oblique, sartorius, quadriceps, adductors, tibialis, calf; muscles-back: trapezius, deltoid, infraspinatus, latissimus, triceps, gluteus, hamstrings, calf; heart: svc, ivc, aorta, pulmonary, pulmonary-veins, ra, la, rv, lv, tricuspid, mitral; brain: frontal, parietal, occipital, temporal, cerebellum, brainstem; cell: membrane, nucleus, nucleolus, er, golgi, mitochondrion, lysosome, centrosome.

height.description: Height in points (default depends on the figure: 340 to 480)
